name: antd Tooltip
summary: The antd Tooltip themed to the aha-tooltip bubble, for an app that still renders antd's Tooltip.
highlights: antd Tooltip with the aha-tooltip look
Already in the shared base theme
lead: New UI uses <aha-tooltip>. An app that still renders antd's Tooltip (React antd v6, Vue ant-design-vue v4) gets the same bubble from the shared base theme: tooltipTheme is that base, exported under its own name so a wrapper can say what it themes. Two implementations, one look.

spec.label: Bubble
spec.value: solid #1A1A1A (aha-tooltip dark), white text, radius 6, padding 6 10, 30px minimum height, max-width 280 then wraps

spec.label: Brand fill
spec.value: spread brandTooltip for the aha-tooltip color="brand" fill, #E70E68

spec.label: Differences
spec.value: antd keeps its own drop shadow, arrow shape, motion and auto-placement; aha-tooltip's hover-tap trigger, help glyph and size lg have no antd equivalent

spec.label: Where
spec.value: in antdBaseTheme, so every ConfigProvider built with dsAntdTheme already gives antd Tooltip this look

props.name: ...brandTooltip
props.desc: Spread for the Vivid Pink brand fill

whenToUse.when: any new UI, React or Vue
an existing antd Tooltip call site not yet moved to aha-tooltip

opinion.note: Prefer <aha-tooltip> for new UI. This theme only stops existing antd tooltips from drifting: the 14px translucent antd bubble was the second tooltip look in apps that use both.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED by the leaf: <aha-tooltip> is the DS component. This contract only maps antd's Tooltip onto the same look so apps that still render it do not drift; measured against the aha-tooltip values.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: A composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page: React and antd load from a CDN and mount on open, using the same shared tooltipTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two vendor libraries at two Ant generations; they converge through the same theme (tooltipTheme). New UI uses <aha-tooltip>, which needs no theme.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs on the rendered CDN-React preview: a real antd v6 Tooltip inside a ConfigProvider bound to the shared base theme.
